changes.new: For a sale at the customer's home (Personal Property Law 426(6)), business day means every day except Sunday and nine named holidays, so Saturday counts.
changes.support: Business days under Article 10-A include Saturdays (426(6)).

unsure: NY-cancel and NY-insurance: GBL 771(1)(h) and (i) prescribe content but no sentence, so no text is loaded; the owner writes the wording.

NY-ppl428-statement and NY-ppl428-form were added because the file says a contract signed at the customer's home needs them; the oral notice in 428(2) and the refund-policy disclosure in 428(4) are rules the contract builder does not print, so oral_notice and same_language were left unchanged because the existing cancellation fields describe the GBL 771 right that applies to every contract, not only door-to-door sales.
Lien Law 71-a(3)(e) bold statement was not added: the file says it applies to new residential construction sales, not home improvement contracts.
GOL 5-903 (cleaning auto-renewal): the file says whether a recurring cleaning contract is a service contract on real property is a reading the text does not settle, so cleaning was left unchanged.
